name: io.github.mogretici/nestlens
title: NestLens
description: Lets an agent read what NestLens recorded in a NestJS app: requests, queries, exceptions and logs.

packageArguments.name: --url
packageArguments.description: Where NestLens is mounted: your application's address plus the dashboard path.

environmentVariables.name: NESTLENS_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Headers sent with every request, as JSON, when NestLens wants credentials.

environmentVariables.name: NESTLENS_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Enable the tools that change data: clear, prune, pause, resolve, tags.
